title: Prototype Pollution in lodash
description: Versions of lodash before 4.17.21 are vulnerable to Prototype Pollution via the template function.

title: Regular Expression Denial of Service in validator
description: Versions of validator before 13.7.0 are vulnerable to ReDoS via the isEmail function.

title: SQL Injection in pg-promise
description: A SQL injection vulnerability exists in pg-promise when using parameterized queries incorrectly.

title: Information Disclosure in express-session
description: Session IDs may be exposed in debug logs when using express-session with debug mode enabled.
